title: Basic Law Enforcement Academy
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units

program.section_heading: Basic Law Enforcement Academy, Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Define and recognize the fundamental duties, obligations, and philosophies of the criminal justice system, and function within the law enforcement field.
Define and recognize situations and scenarios relating to application of the California Penal Code, California Health and Safety Code, and the California Vehicle Code, and apply the appropriate law.
Define and recognize the techniques of crime scene searches, courtroom demeanor, and criminal investigation related to child abuse and sexual assault situations.

notes: Outcomes are taken from the page's Program Student Learning Outcomes tab. The overview prints the same three PSLOs (numbered 'PSLO – 1.' etc.) with different capitalization ('California health and safety code', 'California vehicle code'); the tab version was recorded.

The overview also lists 15 'measurable skills and abilities' from the RBC's 42 learning domains; these were read as course/academy domain objectives, not program learning outcomes, and were not recorded as outcomes. A reviewer may wish to check this.

The catalog column header is 'Units/Hours'; the requirements total is printed as 'Total Units for the Certificate 35.5', so the award was recorded in units. The text also describes POSC V01 as 910 hours and POSC V01A as 80 hours.
The overview's visible text is cut off mid-sentence in the enrollment clearance requirements; the requirements tab appears complete.
Careers recorded from the description: 'peace officers' (becoming peace officers), 'law enforcement officers', 'police officer', and 'reserve officer' (suggested for applicants under 21).
